rows.sample:
B=/media/j/JPM/a/user/storage/function/ebible_version_download
NT="MAT MRK LUK JHN ACT ROM 1CO 2CO GAL EPH PHP COL 1TH 2TH 1TI 2TI TIT PHM HEB JAS 1PE 2PE 1JN 2JN 3JN JUD REV"
for bk in $NT; do
  for f in $B/cebulb/${bk}[0-9][0-9].htm; do
    c=$(basename $f .htm)
    e=$B/engbsb/$c.htm
    [ -f "$e" ] || { echo "$c ENGLISH-MISSING"; continue; }
    cv=$(grep -oE 'class="verse[^"]*"[^>]*>[0-9]+' $f | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | sort -n | tr '\n' ',')
    ev=$(grep -oE 'class="verse[^"]*"[^>]*>[0-9]+' $e | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | sort -n | tr '\n' ',')
    [ "$cv" = "$ev" ] || echo "$c ceb=$(echo $cv | tr -cd ',' | wc -c) eng=$(echo $ev | tr -cd ',' | wc -c)"
  done
done
